tasks.subject: Task 1: Preserve section_activity across DB rebuilds
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A committed script that saves and restores the one table a rebuild destroys, so Tasks 3 and 4 cannot silently lose user data.

**Files:**
- Create: scripts/preserve-activity.mjs
- Test: test/preserve-activity.test.js

**Verify:** node --test test/preserve-activity.test.js

```json:metadata
{"files":["scripts/preserve-activity.mjs","test/preserve-activity.test.js",".gitignore"],"verifyCommand":"node --test test/preserve-activity.test.js","acceptanceCriteria":["save writes backup json","restore is idempotent","missing backup exits 0","round trip preserves all four columns"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Correct false and stale statements in shipped copy
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Stop claiming a statistic the code does not compute, a target count wrong in five places, and drug examples removed from the atlas.

**Files:**
- Create: test/plate-copy.test.js
- Modify: public/neuroreceptor_pharmacology_explorer_dashboard.html, DESIGN.md, scripts/sourcing/README.md, scripts/sourcing/config.mjs

**Verify:** node --test test/plate-copy.test.js && npm test

```json:metadata
{"files":["test/plate-copy.test.js","public/neuroreceptor_pharmacology_explorer_dashboard.html","DESIGN.md","scripts/sourcing/README.md","scripts/sourcing/config.mjs"],"verifyCommand":"node --test test/plate-copy.test.js && npm test","acceptanceCriteria":["no geometric mean claim","target count matches AFF_TARGETS.length","primer examples cite only current roster"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Require a decisive margin before naming a subtype
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Stop crowning a subtype that beats its runner-up by less than measurement noise. Mirtazapine alpha_2 reports Alpha2C on a 0.04 log-unit lead over Alpha2A.

**Files:**
- Modify: scripts/sourcing/config.mjs (MIN_SUBTYPE_MARGIN = 0.3), scripts/sourcing/3-build.mjs (represent()), test/binding-dispersion.test.js

**Verify:** node --test test/binding-dispersion.test.js && npm test

```json:metadata
{"files":["scripts/sourcing/config.mjs","scripts/sourcing/3-build.mjs","test/binding-dispersion.test.js","scripts/sourcing/README.md"],"verifyCommand":"node --test test/binding-dispersion.test.js && npm test","acceptanceCriteria":["mirtazapine alpha_2 sub undefined and weak 1","guanfacine alpha_2 sub Alpha2A","rebuild completed with activity restored"]}
```
